notes.title: Update 0.1.5 Meta Progression & Release of Final Demo
notes.notes:
Final Demo is Complete!
We are excited to announce that the final demo is officially complete! This update comes packed with new features like achievements, permanent upgrades, and numerous quality-of-life improvements. After three months of dedicated playtesting and gathering player feedback, we’ve crafted a demo that reflects the community’s input. Your suggestions truly shaped the game, and I’ve done my best to integrate everything you asked for.

The Meta Progression Project
This is the largest and most game-changing feature yet! Players can now pursue achievements and collect valuable Eco Essence, which can be spent on permanent upgrades. These upgrades offer enhanced automation, new strategic options, and a more engaging early-game experience with every level.

Key Updates in Version 0.1.5


 Progress Hub: A brand-new Progress Hub allows players to purchase permanent upgrades and assemble their ultimate team of companions. Accessible after each completed level, it’s your gateway to long-term progress.
 Eco Essence: Earn Eco Essence by completing achievements, then spend it in the Progress Hub to unlock powerful upgrades that carry over between levels.
 Permanent Upgrades: Based on your feedback, we’ve added permanent upgrades to reduce the repetitive early-game grind and make each new level feel more rewarding.
 Visual Improvements: Companion selection and reveals have been overhauled for a more cohesive and visually appealing experience.
 Performance Enhancements: Lighting has been optimized, reducing the game's file size and improving overall performance.
 Streamlined Controls: You can now hold the mouse button to continuously shoot enemies and spawn food, significantly reducing the need for repetitive clicking.
 Audio Additions: We’ve added sound effects to the level completion menu for a more immersive experience.
 Faster Scene Navigation: Improved transitions between scenes for quicker loading times.


A heartfelt thank you to the community for your unwavering support and invaluable feedback throughout development. You’ve helped shape this game into something truly special!

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
Exciting New Updates!

 Level Completion Screen: After finishing a level, you'll now see a stats screen showing how you did and what achievements you collected.

 Level Replay: From the main menu, you can now access the level selection screen to replay any level you've completed.

 Achievement Tracker: In the level selection screen, you can view the achievements you've earned and see which ones you're still missing for each level.

 Weapon Upgrades: Weapon damage scaling has been increased, making it much more rewarding to upgrade your weapons!

 Granite Guardian: The health of the Granite Guardian has been reduced.

 Animal Behavior: Animals will no longer spawn valuables or go hungry when an enemy is invading.

 Screen Shake Option: You can now disable screen shake in the settings.

 New Adventure Warning: A warning message has been added when you start a new adventure.

 How To Play Menu: The How To Play menu has been updated to allow endless scrolling.

 Enemy Warning Update: The enemy warning now includes the number and types of enemies spawning.

 Fox and Rabbits: Removed the death sound when foxes eat rabbits to indicate that it doesn't count towards achievements.

 Level 1-1 Pop-Up: The "maximum food" pop-up in level 1-1 now only appears twice.


Bug Fixes
Too many to count, but we've squashed a bunch! 🐛

Enjoy the new features and improvements!

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Quality of life changes and small bug fixes

A lot of people have been playing Equiverse and I couldn't be happier with the positive feedback it received! A week ago I released the demo and I have tried to listen to all the feedback I got. To celebrate the success of the demo in the first week I wanted to update the game and already implement some of the feedback!

Here is a list


Quality of life


  From level 1-2, players get more starting Leafpoints to speed up the early game.

 Added How to play tutorial with short videos to give you a relaxed way to learn the game at your own pace before starting! Also accesible from the pause menu in a level!

 Added mouse input for camera movement. Hold right mouse button to rotate and scroll the mousewheel to zoom in and zoom out.

 Q and E keyboard keys can now be used to zoom in and zoom out.

 Changed camera angles to give a better view of the ecosystem!

 Changing the graphics quality to medium or low makes a significantly bigger impact on your performance!


Bug fixes


 Fixed a bug where in the main menu the hitbox of buttons seems to be too low

 Made interpunction across UI persistent

 Fixed a bug where the button in the companion scene can be pressed multiple times in a row which makes the audio sound a bit strange
